newsitem.title: USA: Sun Penn. refinery units seen up at weekend.
newsitem.headline: Sun Penn. refinery units seen up at weekend.

text.p: The downed refinery units at Sun Co Inc's Marcus Hook, Pennsylvania refinery should be brought back on line over the weekend, a Sun spokesman told Reuters Thursday.
"The cat cracker is coming back up over the weekend as is the crude unit," said Bud Davis, a spokesman for the Philadelphia-based refining and marketing company.
Sun has previously said it was delaying the restart of the 80,000 barrel per day (bpd) crude distillation unit to coincide with the restart of an 85,000 bpd catalystic cracking unit.
Sun pulled the units off line on October 4 for scheduled mainetance at the 175,000 bpd Marcus Hook refinery.
-- Oliver Ludwig, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
